senses.gloss:
m. (-कः)
The onion; also मुकुन्दक.

f. (-कुः)
Freedom, liberation.
E.
मुच to let loose, कु aff.

n. (-टं)
A crest, a diadem, a tiara.
f. (-टी)
Snapping the fingers.
E.
मकि to adorn, aff. उट, and उ substituted for the radical vowel, form irr.; also मकुट.

m. (-न्दः)
1 A name of VIṢṆU.
2 Gum olibanum.
3 A precious gem.
4 Quicksilver.
5 One of KUVERA'S Nidhis, or divine treasures.
E.
मुकु liberation, (from passion, &c.) in the second case मुकुं, and टा to give, aff. क, or मुच to liberate, or मुकु as before, उन्द to wet, to sprinkle, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
An onion; also मुकन्दक.

m. (-न्दुः)
Gum olibanum; also मुकुन्द.

m. (-रः)
1 A mirror.
2 The handle of a potter's lathe.
3 A tree, (Mimusops elengi.)
4 A bud.
5 Arabian jasmine.
E.
मक to adorn, उरच् Uṇādi aff., and उ optionally substituted for the radical vowel, deriv. irr.; also मकुर.

mn. (-लः-लं)
1 An opening bud.
2 The body.
3 The soul or spirit.
E.
मुच to let loose, (the flower, &c.) उलच् aff., and च changed to क.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Half-closed, (as a bud.)
2 Half-shut, (as the eye,) blinking, winking.
E.
मुकुल, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Closed, shut, (as a bud.)
E.
मुकुल, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.

n. (-कं)
A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus lobatus.) Also मकुष्ठक, &c.

m. (-कः)
A plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.)
E.
मकि to adorn, ऊलच् aff. कन् added, उ substituted for the radical vowel, deriv. irr.; also मकूलक.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Released, liberated, loosed, let go.
2 Liberated from corporal existence, finally happy.
3 Discharged, loosed as a weapon; this may be in two ways, as पाणिमुक्त thrown with the hand, as a dart, &c., and यन्त्रमुक्त thrown from an instrument, as an arrow from a bow, &c.
n. (-क्तं)
The spirit released from mundane existence, and re-integrated with its divine original.
f. (-क्ता)
A pearl.
E.
मुच to set free, aff. क्त.

n. (-कं)
1 Any missile weapon.
2 A stanza or sentence completing the sense of a passage.
E.
मुक्त loosed, let fly, and कन् added.

m. (-कः)
A snake that has cast his slough.
E.
मुक्त let loose, and कञ्चुक the slough of a snake.

ind.
Aloud, as shouting or crying.
E.
मुक्त, and कण्ठ throat.

m. (-क्षुः)
A lion.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
Disinterested, free from worldly attachment or improper bias.
E.
मुक्त, and सङ्ग attachment.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Parting with, giving away, liberal.
2 Loosed, let go.
E.
मुक्त, and हस्त the hand.

m. (-पः)
A pearl necklace, a string of pearls.
E.
मुक्ता a pearl, and कलाप a sort of chain.

n. (-रं)
The pearl oyster.
E.
मुक्ता a pearl, and आगार abode.

m. (-म्बः)
A pearl necklace.
E.
मुक्ता a pearl, and प्रलम्ब string.

f. (-सूः)
The pearl oyster.
E.
मुक्ता a pearl, and प्रसू mother, mother of pearl.

n. (-लं)
1 Camphor.
2 A pearl.
3 A sort of fruit, the custard apple.
E.
मुक्ता a pearl, and फल fruit, comparable to a pearl in whiteness.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Loosed, and not loosed; applied especially to weapons which may be wielded or hurled, as a club, a javelin, &c.
E.
मुक्त loosed, अमुक्त not loosed.

f. (-ता)
A pearl necklace.
E.
मुक्ता a pearl, and लता a creeping plant.

f. (-ली)
A pearl necklace.
E.
मुक्ता a pearl, and आवली a line, a row.

mf. (-टः-टा)
A pearl oyster.
E.
मुक्ता a pearl, and स्फुट to burst, aff. घञ्.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Final beatitude, the delivery of the soul from the body and exemption from further transmigration; the re-absorption of the emancipated spirit into its great primary source, identification with GOD.
2 Liberation, setting or becoming free or loose.
E.
मुघ to let loose, aff. क्तिन्.

ind.
Having set free, loose, &c.
E.
मुच to free, क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Dumb.
m. (-कः)
1 A fish.
2 A demon.
3 A pauper.
E.
मू imitative sound, and कै to utter, aff. क, or मू to bind, कक् aff.
